questions.question:
**Rearrange the parts of the sentence in correct order.**

Tarapur agreement guaranteed supplies of

P: Tarapur reactors for entire life

Q: enriched uranium fuel from

R: the US for running the
questions.solution:
Here the correct answer is **QRP**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**:-

 
• A sentence can't end with **fuel from **or **the** i.e.** P** has to be last.
 
• Thus, we can eliminate** option 1 **and** 4**.
 
• **R** can't be first as it starts with **the US **and you can't have supplies of a country.
 
• Supplies is of a material i.e. uranium in the context of the sentence.
 
• Thus,** Q** will be the first sentence.
 
• Therefore, the correct sequence is **QRP**.

 

***Correct Sentence - **Tarapur agreement guaranteed supplies of enriched uranium fuel from the US for running the Tarapur reactors for entire life. *

questions.question:
**A sentence has been given in Active/Passive Voice. Out of the four given alternatives, select the one which best expresses the same sentence in Passive/Active Voice.**

Viraat threw the stone.

options.text: The stone got threw by Viraat.
The stone is thrown by Viraat.
The stone was thrown by Viraat.

questions.solution:
Here the correct answer is **The stone was thrown by Viraat.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**:-

__
 
• The above-given sentence is in the active voice. 
 
• We need to change it in the passive voice.
 
• The following steps are required to change the given sentence into **passive voice**:-
 
 
• The subject 'Viraat' of the active voice will become the object of the passive voice.
 
• The object 'the stone' of the active voice will become the subject of the passive voice.
 
• The tense(simple past tense) will change according to the following structure:-
 
 
• Active Voice - Subject + (did + V1) or (V2)+ Object.
 
• Passive Voice - Object + was/were + V3 + by + Object.
 
 
 
 

Therefore, the correct passive voice is *The stone was thrown by Viraat.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• When we convert active voice to passive voice, three things need to be kept in mind:-

 
 
• Change object into subject.
 
• Change subject into object.
 
• Always use the third form of verb in the passive voice.
 
• Use 'by' before the new object.

questions.question:
**A sentence has been given in Direct/Indirect Speech. Out of the four given alternatives, select the one which best expresses the same sentence in Indirect/Direct Speech.**

“You have all done very badly!” remarked the mother.

options.text: The mother asked if they have done badly.
The mother remarked that they have did it badly.
The mother said that they had done badly.
The mother remarked that they had all done very badly.

questions.solution:
Here the correct answer is **The mother remarked that they had all done very badly.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**:-

__
 
• Let's look at the steps for changing the sentence from direct to indirect speech:
 
• As the reporting verb is in the **past tense** and direct speech is in the **present perfect tense, **we will take the following steps:-
 
 
• The reporting verb 'remarked' is unchanged.
 
• The conjunction 'that' is used in place of the comma and the inverted comma are removed.
 
• The present perfect **tense** is changed to past perfect tense in the direct speech.(**Have** changes to **had**)
 
• Since you is being used in the plural sense here (notice all), it changes to they.
 
• 
 
We can't just remove any piece of info from the sentence. Notice how option 3 doesn't contain all and very.

 
 
 

Therefore, the correct indirect speech is *The mother remarked that they had all done very badly.*

 

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

The following table will enable us to know how tense changes in indirect speech:-

 
 

 Direct Speech
 Indirect Speech
 
 

 Simple Present* (Subject + V1 + Object)*
 Simple Past* (Subject + V2 + Object)*
 
 

 Present Continuous *(Subject + is/am/are + V1 + ing + Object)*
 Past Continuous *(Subject + was/were + V1 + ing + Object)*
 
 

 Present Perfect *(Subject + has/have + V3 + Object)*
 Past Perfect* (Subject + had + V3 + Object)*
 
 

 Simple Past* (Subject + V2 + Object)*
 Past Perfect *(Subject + had + V3 + Object)*
 
 

 Past Continuous *(Subject + was/were + V1 + ing + Object)*
 Past Perfect Continuous* (Subject + had been + V1 + ing + Object)*
 
 

 Simple Future *(Subject + will/shall + V1 + Object)*
 Present Conditional *(Subject + would + V1 +Object)*
 
 

 Future Continuous *(Subject + will/shall + V1 + ing + Object)*
 Conditional Continuous *(Subject + would + be + V1 + ing + Object)*

questions.question:
**In the following question, out of the four alternatives, select the alternative which will improve the bracketed part of the sentence. In case no improvement is needed, select "no improvement".**

With all this my mind wandered back to my brother who (had gone) to play basketball.
questions.solution:
Here the correct answer is **No Improvement.**

• The sentence contains **two conditions.**
 
• Firstly, the action of *his brother going *happened.
 
• Then, his *mind wandered.*
 
• Thus, the action that has taken place earlier would be expressed in** past perfect tense***(had gone)* and the action that has taken place later will be expressed in **simple past tense***(wandered)*.
 
• So, the sentence requires** no improvement.**

**Therefore, the correct sentence is*** With all this my mind wandered back to my brother who had gone to play basketball.*
